name: showdown
notes: The clicks/ directory holds eval.py, scripts and model integrations for Ace, Claude, Gemini, Molmo, OmniParser, OpenAI, OpenAI CUA, Qwen and UI-TARS; its .gitignore excludes data/*, and the README links the showdown-clicks-dev data on Hugging Face. The README reports accuracy with bootstrapped 95% intervals and latency per model on the 557-click dev subset of a 5,679-click collection.
summary: Evaluation code for the showdown-clicks benchmark: eval.py checks whether a model's predicted click on a macOS screenshot lands in the annotated bounding box, with integrations for Claude, Qwen, UI-TARS and others.
